prompt: You have a test tomorrow afternoon and by 10 pm you have covered the main topics. Which choice best supports your memory?

options.text: Keep studying until 2 am to go over everything twice more
Use energy drinks and study through the whole night
Skip sleep and do all the revision in the morning instead
Stop for the night, get a full night's sleep, and do a brief review in the morning

explanation: Sleep plays an important role in consolidating memories formed during the day, so a full night's sleep plus a short morning review usually serves recall better than exhausted extra hours.
